newsitem.title: UK: Scottish Highland plans to float shares in Nov..
newsitem.headline: Scottish Highland plans to float shares in Nov..

text.p: Scottish Highland Hotels Plc said on Tuesday it would float on the stock exchange through a placing, which would raise 12.79 million stg.
The placing price of 125p per share capitalises the hotels group at 30.4 million stg. It said it expected dealings in its ordinary shares to start on November 11.

Scottish Highland forecast pre-tax profit of not less than 2.1 million stg for the year ending October 31, 1996, up 48 percent on the previous year. It sees turnover increasing by five percent to 16.47 million and predicts earnings per ordinary share will not be less than 10.1p.
Scottish Highland said the net proceeds of the placing available to the group would be used to repay part of its debt and strengthen the group's balance sheet.
The 10.24 million shares being placed represent 42 percent of the enlarged issued share capital.
Scottish Highland said the placing had been fully underwritten by Bell Lawrie White & Co.
It said the first regular dividend payment would be an interim dividend payout for the year to October 31, 1997.

However, it added that given the long period between admission and the regular payout it would recommend, in the absence of unforeseen circumstances, a final net dividend for the year ending October 31, 1996 of not less than 0.5p payable in February 1997.
